title: GPIO, strapping pins, and electrical limits

spans.text: Goal: apply “GPIO, strapping pins, and electrical limits” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Pin selection must be checked against the exact module and board schematic. In a project, follow this guidance: A GPIO number is not necessarily the connector's physical pin position.

Some ESP32 GPIOs are sampled at boot; others are input-only or reserved. Check the board schematic for flash/PSRAM, USB, and strapping pins, and respect chip voltage levels.
